'''Gremlin Merc''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. It starts with {{BD2|Surprise}} and {{BD2|Thievery}}, stealing gold with each attack. When the Gremlin Merc is killed, it summons a {{M2|Fat Gremlin}} and a {{M2|Sneaky Gremlin}}.

== Gremlin Merc ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Gremlin Merc
|Image  = StS2_Gremlin Merc.png
|HP     = 47-49
|AscHP  = 51-53
|Powers = {{BD2|Surprise}}<br>{{BD2|Thievery}} 20
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Normal
}}
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Surprise
|Image        = StS2 Icon Surprise.png
|Description  = Something is off about this creature...
|Type         = Buff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
}}
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Thievery
|Image        = StS2 Icon Thievery.png
|Description  = Steals X Gold when Attacking.
|Type         = Buff
|Stacks       = Intensity
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Gremlin Merc}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Gimme
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (7x2;{{Asc2|8|8x2}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Double Smash
|Intent = Attack3, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (6x2;{{Asc2|8|7x2}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Weak}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Weak
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hehe
|Intent = Attack2, Buff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|8|9}}) damage. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Cycles through its moves in a fixed order:
# {{Int2|Gremlin Merc|Gimme}}
# {{Int2|Gremlin Merc|Double Smash}}
# {{Int2|Gremlin Merc|Hehe}}
# Back to {{Int2|Gremlin Merc|Gimme}}

When the Gremlin Merc dies, its {{BD2|Surprise}} power triggers, summoning a {{M2|Fat Gremlin}} and a {{M2|Sneaky Gremlin}}. The Fat Gremlin inherits the stolen gold via {{BD2|Heist}}.

=== Dialogue ===
When first using {{Int2|Gremlin Merc|Gimme}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|gold|shake|Money!}}

{{TS|orange|up|Money!}}
</i></blockquote>

{{Clear}}

== Sneaky Gremlin ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Sneaky Gremlin
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Gremlin Merc#Sneaky Gremlin
|Image  = StS2_Sneaky Gremlin.png
|HP     = 10-14
|AscHP  = 11-15
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Minion
}}
The Sneaky Gremlin is a minion summoned when the Gremlin Merc dies.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Sneaky Gremlin}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spawned
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = Wakes up. Does nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tackle
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|10}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Sneaky Gremlin|Spawned}} on its first turn (does nothing), then uses {{Int2|Sneaky Gremlin|Tackle}} every turn after.

{{Clear}}

== Fat Gremlin ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Fat Gremlin
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Gremlin Merc#Fat Gremlin
|Image  = StS2_Fat Gremlin.png
|HP     = 13-17
|AscHP  = 14-18
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Minion
|Powers = {{BD2|Heist}}
}}
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Heist
|Image        = StS2 Icon Heist.png
|Description  = When killed, returns all the stolen Gold.
|Type         = Buff
|Stacks       = Intensity
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
}}
The Fat Gremlin is a minion summoned when the Gremlin Merc dies. It carries any gold the Gremlin Merc stole.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Fat Gremlin}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spawned
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = Wakes up. Does nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Flee
|Intent = Escape
|Effect = Flees from combat with any stolen gold.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Fat Gremlin|Spawned}} on its first turn (does nothing), then uses {{Int2|Fat Gremlin|Flee}} every turn after, escaping with the stolen gold.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Fat Gremlin|Flee}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|orange|shake|I'm outta here!}}
</i></blockquote>


{{Clear}}

== Useful Cards ==
* Frontloaded damage from cards like {{C2|Assassinate}} can help finish off the '''Gremlin Merc''' before it steals too much of your money.
* Recovering {{KW2|Gold}} lost via {{BD2|Thievery}} will trigger {{R2|Dragon Fruit}}.
** The recovered Gold can be bolstered via {{R2|Bowler Hat}}.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Gremlin Merc''' is actually two Gremlins disguised as the {{M|Gremlin Leader}}.
* One of the accessories worn by the '''Gremlin Merc''' appears to be a {{R2|Kunai}}.

* '''Gremlin Merc''' is the only Enemy in the game whose attack damage increases at {{Asc2|8|Ascension}} instead of {{Asc2|9|Ascension}}.
* '''Fat Gremlin''' and '''Sneaky Gremlin''' are the only enemies in Slay the Spire 2 to share a name with enemies from Slay the Spire 1.
* '''Fat Gremlin''' is one of only 4 enemies in the game to be incapable of causing damage, the other three being the {{M2|Noisebot}}, {{M2|Guardbot}}, and {{M2|Eye With Teeth}}.
